mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM article a INNER JOIN follow f ON f.followed_id = a.author_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.* FROM article a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY (a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) DESC, (COALESCE(a.view_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(a.collect_count, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) * 4) DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
